recipe_version.title: Turkey Sloppy Joes with Quick Garlic Zucchini
recipe_version.description: A 25-minute family favorite: ground turkey simmered with onion, green pepper, and a tangy-sweet tomato, cider vinegar, and brown sugar sauce until thick and saucy, piled onto toasted buns. Served with garlicky skillet zucchini.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.preparation: 2 minced for the filling, 2 sliced for the zucchini

ingredients.name: hamburger buns
ingredients.display_name: soft seedless hamburger buns whose label lists no milk, butter, or egg
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no milk, butter, or egg, and no sesame topping

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Dice the onion and bell pepper, mince 2 cloves garlic and slice 2, and slice the zucchini. Split the buns.

steps.title: Brown the turkey
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Cook the turkey, onion, and pepper, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains, 7 minutes; add the minced garlic for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Stir in the tomato sauce, tomato paste, brown sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, chili powder, 3/4 tsp salt, and the pepper. Simmer on medium-low, stirring, until thick, 8 minutes. Meanwhile heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium-high and cook the zucchini with the sliced garlic and 1/2 tsp salt until browned at the edges, 6 minutes (overlap stated).

steps.title: Toast and serve
steps.body: Toast the buns cut side down in a dry skillet or toaster, pile the filling on the bottoms, close, and serve with the zucchini.

equipment: baking sheet or toaster for buns
